comparison.objective: Carry a full cup around an open laptop and place it on a coaster without spilling.
comparison.physical_skill: Upright transport, clearance planning, and gentle placement.
comparison.success_condition: Cup reaches the coaster upright while avoiding the laptop, unsafe proximity, spill proxies, and hard landing.
comparison.reason: This tests hazard-aware transport and spill avoidance, not precision bridging and continuous internal support of a bearing carriage.
